scope: Artificial one-He simple-cubic insulating KS-LDA cell, not an equilibrium solid-helium prediction.

xc.convention: Dirac exchange plus spin-unpolarized VWN5 correlation

implementation: Original reproducibility/validation driver using PySCF periodic KRKS, FFTDF and Libxc; not a new DFT engine.
energy_convention: Hartree per neutral primitive cell including the ionic Ewald contribution, without fitted constant shifts.

independent_comparison.scope: Two independently implemented engines with different finite orbital representations; compare total per-cell energies within a stated finite-basis budget, not bitwise equality.
